equity_ladder.csv and options_ladder.csv were produced by the methodology-fixes work (see docs/FIXES.md, 'Measured effect') from four
isolated data vintages (published, +fix1 open-book cap, +fix1+2 point-in-time deciles, all fixes; options: fix3-only, fix2-only, all).
Copied unchanged from the folder one level above the worktree. The paper builder cross-checks 'published' against the saved *_legacy
runs and 'all' against the saved current runs.
